items.summary: Edited my review. The game is still awesome! The voices, the art style, the story (I bawled my eyes out when Aigis and Jenkin died. You owe me an apology). I also found out that Doresain has the same VA as Toji from JJK and Nikolai from BSD! Anyways, the rewards are generous. I've probably already gotten more than half the characters because the gacha system is nice. It's just that my phone crashes, but it's my phone's fault. Overall, I'd recommend this to my friends. A great game!!
items.author: Jin Kisaragi
